newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Court defines delivery of raw tobacco under Community rules.
newsitem.headline: Court defines delivery of raw tobacco under Community rules.

text.p: The European Court of Justice said on Thursday the concept of "delivery" of tobacco must be interpreted at Community level because it constitutes a key component of the premium system in the raw tobacco sector.
Buratti of Italy gave raw tobacco to TAV, a tobacco association of producers to which it belongs. The tobacco was stored in a warehouse owned by a tobacco processing cooperative.
When the tobacco went into storage between August and December 1993, the processing cooperative expressly stated in delivery notes that it did not take control of the tobacco.
According to VAT statements, the tobacco was not transferred to the processors until January of 1994.

The court found that the term "delivery" under the Community premium system for raw tobacco refers to the delivery from producers to processors, and not to an indivudiual producer's contribution to a group of producers.
"It is for the national court to determine when the delivery of tobacco took place, taking into account all the factual circumstances surrounding the supply of the tobacco," the court said.
(Court translation into English. Original language of the case: Italian)

"Common organization of the market - Raw tobacco - Commission regulation (EEC) No 3478/92 - Premium system for raw tobacco - Calculation of the premium to be paid by a group of producers to the individual producer"
Reference from the Pretura Circondariale, Verona, Sezione Distaccata di Isola della Scala (Italy) for a preliminary ruling between
Impresa Agricola Buratti Leonardo, Pierluigi e Livio
Tabacchicoltori Associati Veneti Soc. coop. arl (TAV)

on the interpretation of articles 10 and 11 of Commission regulation (EEC) No 3478/92 of 1 December 1992 laying down detailed rules for the application of the premium system for raw tobacco (OJ 1992 L 351, p. 17), as amended by Commission regulation (EEC) No 3477/93 of 17 December 1993 concerning the agricultural conversion rates to be applied in the tobacco sector (OJ 1993 L 317, p. 30),

The terms "delivery under contract" and "delivery" used respectively in article 10 of Commission regulation (EEC) No 3478/92 of 1 December 1992 laying down detailed rules for the application of the premium system for raw tobacco, and article 1 of Commission regulation (EEC) No 3477/93 of 17 December 1993 concerning the agricultural conversion rates to be applied in the tobacco sector are to be interpreted, where the processor has concluded a cultivation contract with a group of producers, as referring to the delivery, by a producer or group of producers to the processor, of a quantity of tobacco to be processed in performance of the cultivation contract.
